narrator.name: Data Dave
narrator.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

output.content: I am copying the raw files from the staging bucket to my local machine again this morning. I run the validation checks by hand and then push the cleaned data to the warehouse. It takes about forty minutes of my time each day. There is no automated scheduler or alerting system attached to this step yet. The initial data pull currently lacks any automated triggers or monitoring, so the process relies entirely on manual execution and immediate attention from the pipeline team. The downstream models receive whatever data is ready at the end of that manual window.
output.reclassify_reason: The text describes the current manual workflow, its duration, and the absence of automation without expressing any wish, refusal, or acceptance of a specific change.
